scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('./portfolio-website/package.json')){cp.execSync('cd portfolio-website && npm install && npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'}); fs.cpSync('./portfolio-website/dist','./dist',{recursive:true});} else {cp.execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'});}"
